name: interruptible-automation
title: Interruptible Automation
description: A bulk file-organizer that runs itself, but genuinely pauses at flagged files instead of only offering a kill switch: a live dot rail tracks all six files by status, and each checkpoint slides in with the exact next move, a plain-language reason it's unsure, and an editable destination picker with a sliding pill, so you can redirect the file before it commits, skip it, or stop the whole run at any moment and leave the rest untouched.
